Do not include secrets, private repository content, or exploit details. Follow
[Security](https://github.com/barisgunduz/craftmentation/blob/HEAD/SECURITY.md)
for sensitive concerns. Search existing issues first.

## Problem

Describe the error and the affected file or repository revision.

## Steps to reproduce

Provide the smallest sanitized example and the steps needed to observe the problem.

## Expected and actual results

Explain what should happen and what you observed. Attach accessible examples if useful.

## Verification and context

List checks actually performed, relevant tools or agent versions if applicable, and
any limitations. The CLI is not implemented yet; do not assume executable behavior.
